_help: Talking manual HELD-OUT questions (step AM3-r, review MED-2): every 3rd question of each group of tests/assistant/questions_<lang>.json in file order, frozen on 2026-11-07. NEVER used for tuning (thresholds, factors, the spoken-word table index.SAID, labels chosen by looking at results): tune on the other questions only (tools/assistant_index.py eval --tuning), then measure these once. NOTE: they were part of the AM3 list, so the AM3 synonym table was written with them in view - the held-out figures are an upper bound until a fresh set exists (AM6). A new question goes into the tuning part unless it is added here at the same time.
